Pericytes are directly involved in the pathogenesis of vascular driven diseases (i.e., diabetic retinopathy and tumor angiogenesis).
In addition, uncontrolled divisions of pericytes give rise to the hemangiopericytoma, a rare vascular tumor that can originate in the body anywhere there are capillaries.
